actual_scope: Quantitative lower bound on the optimal worst-case recovery fiber of PR6660 refined chains at every depth t>=27, from its zero-fiber kernel formula: |fiber(0)| >= F^t (1+(2^d-1) mu_d^(t/(2^d-1))) for 1<=d<=4t-104, with mu_d exact; at t=27 this is > 15.7897 F^27, i.e. at least 696 tag bits versus 692 for a direct sum. Explicit 27-frame sequence attains 1+12rho2^25+3rho2^26 (15.789775 F^27), which is the exact minimum depth-27 zero fiber over all frame sequences.
scope_change_reason: Answers the first step of PR6660 open question 1 (minimize the zero-fiber kernel sum at t=27 over overlap patterns) with a bound for every overlap pattern. Like its predecessor this is precision-state accounting in the analytic_recovery interface, not a caller-bound discharge of a selected assumption.

stop_rule: Stop at the all-pattern zero-fiber floor with an exact t=27 constant and its near-attainment by an abstract pattern; leave the exact max-fiber optimum and realizability by frames open.
